title: Dirab qilsa sadih xongolo
intro: Aamanti le rooci tellemmo abeenit kee tellemmo abeenit fanat yekke baaxol qeedaalisso elle obteeh, qeedaalisso uxxuk sugte. Tama num dubuk sooleh yan inkih tan agattiinah giclo, qadliino kee Inki Numma Yallih qibaadah ken seeca. Farmo qaduk sugtem kee seeco hununuh sugtem takkay immay, ummatta ankacissam cinteh, finqak sugte. Atu tama farmoyti Qur'aanak baxissam duuddaa?
clues: anu farmoyti akkuk ruube ummattay mano keenik tellemmoo kee badaaqat mermeritta.
Yi ummatta baaxol inkih ux qeedaalisso yaceenim kee qilsat aylahsaanamal tamixxige.
oson kalah qarkakisak gexentitte gital kee umaadoobi baxcisaanam ardi bagul.
Anu Yalla dubuk akah taamitaanam kee sinam lih abaanah yanin angaarawal inki gabuuk qadleena loonum keenil kassiisa.
oson yi farmo cineenih yoo kee yollih yaamine mara baaxok diiriyoonuh meysisen.
Yalli yoo kee yi katayta isi racmattat cateeh, zalim-abeenit gibdi digaalah tibbixeh.

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًۭا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَـٰرِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ
verse: And when Our command came, We saved Shuʿayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone (11:94)
